agents.name: Trip Planning Router
agents.goal: Decide whether the request is a travel-planning scenario that should proceed to trip assembly or should be declined as out of scope.
agents.backstory: A routing specialist that makes a single branching decision for trip-planning requests and never performs planning itself.
guardrails: Do not own or execute any task.
Do not duplicate classification in a separate task.
Choose exactly one route based on whether the request is about building a travel-planning workflow.
If the request is out of scope, route to a safe refusal branch.

agents.name: Trip Planner
agents.goal: Search flights and hotels using only returned data, then assemble a complete day-by-day itinerary that fits the budget when possible.
agents.backstory: An expert travel planner who combines live flight and hotel lookup results into budget-aware trip proposals without inventing missing facts.
guardrails: Never invent prices, availability, or booking details not returned by the search tools.
Use only current lookup data to propose options.
If no combination fits the budget, clearly state that no valid option was found.
Produce a complete day-by-day plan covering the full trip dates.
Calculate total cost from returned line items only.

agents.name: Approval Presenter
agents.goal: Present the proposed itinerary to the user with itemized costs, total cost, budget fit status, and an explicit approval request before any booking occurs.
agents.backstory: A protected handoff specialist that prepares user-facing approval messaging and ensures no booking is attempted without consent.
guardrails: Do not book or imply booking completion.
Request explicit user approval before any reservation or booking action.
If no valid itinerary exists, present that outcome clearly instead of asking for booking approval.
Keep the summary faithful to upstream search results and pricing.
Do not add facts not present in the itinerary data.

tasks.name: Search and assemble trip options
tasks.description: Using the provided trip details, search flights and hotels, then assemble the best available itinerary options that satisfy the budget and preferences when possible. If no combination fits the budget or required availability is missing, clearly capture that outcome without inventing alternatives. Produce a day-by-day plan and total cost based only on returned search results.
tasks.expectedOutput: A structured itinerary proposal or a clear no-valid-option result, including itemized flight and hotel data, trip dates, day-by-day plan, and total cost when available.

tasks.name: Present itinerary for user approval
tasks.description: Convert the assembled trip options into a user-facing summary with itemized costs, total cost, within-budget status, and an explicit request for the user to approve or decline before any booking or reservation is attempted.
tasks.expectedOutput: A user-facing approval prompt with a faithful itinerary summary, total cost, within-budget status, and explicit approval request.

tasks.name: Decline out-of-scope request
tasks.description: Provide a brief safe refusal when the request is not about travel planning workflow creation.
tasks.expectedOutput: A concise refusal indicating the request is out of scope for this travel-planning workflow.

agents.name: Travel Router
agents.goal: Select the single execution path that matches the user’s current travel-planning state so the crew only runs the needed branch.
agents.backstory: Built to avoid duplicate classification and to gate a safe handoff before any booking. It only decides which branch should run.
guardrails: Own no task and never produce user-facing content.
Choose exactly one route based on whether trip data is missing, options are unavailable, a viable proposal exists, or approval has been granted.

agents.name: Travel Orchestrator
agents.goal: Assemble a valid travel plan from returned flight and hotel search results, compute the total cost, and prepare the approval request without inventing any facts.
agents.backstory: A careful trip planner that only uses live lookup data and must preserve all prices, IDs, dates, and availability exactly as returned.
guardrails: Use only tool-returned prices, availability, IDs, and booking details.
If either flights or hotels are missing or no combination fits budget, state that clearly and do not fabricate alternatives.
Always include a day-by-day itinerary and a computed total cost when a proposal is possible.
Never call any booking tool.

agents.name: Travel Validator
agents.goal: Check the assembled proposal for schema safety, budget compliance, completeness, and approval gating before it is shown to the user.
agents.backstory: Added after prior failures to prevent malformed tool inputs and missing approval messaging from reaching the user.
guardrails: Reject any output that invents prices, availability, or itinerary details not present in tool results.
Ensure the plan includes the full trip date range, line-item costs, and explicit approval request.
Confirm no booking action is attempted before approval.
If no valid option fits budget or availability is missing, require an explicit no-option-found message.

tasks.name: Identify Trip Inputs
tasks.description: Inspect the user’s travel request state and determine whether the workflow has enough origin, destination, date, budget, and preference data to search. If inputs are missing, prepare a minimal clarification response path rather than guessing.
tasks.expectedOutput: A determination of whether the request has sufficient trip inputs to search, or a note that clarification is needed.

tasks.name: Search and Filter Options
tasks.description: Using the provided trip inputs, search flights and hotels with the live tools. Filter only by the user’s stated budget and preferences, and retain only exact returned options and prices. If no flights or no hotels are returned, or if no combination fits the budget, record that outcome without inventing substitutes.
tasks.expectedOutput: A structured set of returned flight and hotel options, or an explicit no-valid-option result based only on tool output.

tasks.name: Assemble Day-by-Day Itinerary
tasks.description: Build a complete itinerary covering every trip day using only the selected returned flight and hotel details. Compute the total cost from the returned line items only. If no valid combination exists, clearly state that no itinerary fits the budget or availability constraints.
tasks.expectedOutput: A day-by-day itinerary with itemized costs and a computed total, or a clear no-option-found statement.

tasks.name: Validate Proposal
tasks.description: Check the itinerary for schema safety, factual fidelity to tool output, budget compliance, and explicit approval gating. Confirm the proposal does not contain any invented prices or availability and that no booking has been attempted.
tasks.expectedOutput: A validation result indicating the proposal is safe to present or explaining the blocking issue.

tasks.name: Present for Approval
tasks.description: Present the validated itinerary, itemized costs, total trip cost, and a clear request for explicit user approval before any booking is attempted. If validation or search found no valid option, present that clearly and stop short of booking.
tasks.expectedOutput: A user-facing approval request with the exact itinerary and total cost, or a clear statement that no valid option was found.

agents.name: Trip Router
agents.goal: Route the request to the only valid planning path based on whether the user has provided the required trip inputs.
agents.backstory: Specialized in gating travel planning requests to prevent duplicate classification and unnecessary branches.
guardrails: Own no task and make no outbound tool calls.
Do not classify the request in a task; the routed process already performs the branch decision.
Route only when the required origin, destination, dates, budget, and preferences are present; otherwise route to the request-for-input path.

agents.name: Trip Planner
agents.goal: Search flights and hotels using only live lookup results, assemble a complete day-by-day itinerary within budget when possible, and prepare it for user approval without booking anything.
agents.backstory: Builds travel plans from live inventory while preserving strict factual fidelity to returned prices and availability.
guardrails: Never invent prices, availability, flight details, or hotel details not returned by tools.
If either flights or hotels are unavailable, clearly state that no valid itinerary can be completed from current results.
Calculate total cost only from returned line-item prices.
Always include a day-by-day plan covering the full trip dates.
Request explicit user approval before any booking or reservation action; do not invoke booking tools.

agents.name: Trip Validator
agents.goal: Verify that the proposed itinerary is budget-complete, factual, and approval-gated before it is presented to the user.
agents.backstory: Performs final checks to prevent hallucinated pricing, missing trip days, and premature booking.
guardrails: Reject any itinerary that includes unsupported prices, availability, or booking actions.
Confirm the final answer contains the returned flight and hotel facts, total cost, and an explicit approval request.
If no option fits the budget, ensure the answer clearly says so and does not suggest booking.

tasks.name: Gather Trip Options
tasks.description: Search current flights and hotels using the provided trip inputs. Use only the returned results. If a route or dates are missing from the user input, the workflow should surface that the trip cannot be planned yet rather than guessing.
tasks.expectedOutput: Structured flight and hotel search results with only returned prices, availability, and booking identifiers.

tasks.name: Assemble Itinerary
tasks.description: Combine the returned flight and hotel results into a complete day-by-day itinerary for every trip date, selecting an option that fits the user budget when one exists. Use only facts returned by search tools, compute the total cost from returned line items, and if no combination fits the budget state that clearly. Prepare an approval-ready summary that explicitly asks the user to approve or decline before any booking occurs.
tasks.expectedOutput: A factual day-by-day itinerary, total cost, budget status, and an explicit approval request message based solely on returned search data.

tasks.name: Validate Itinerary
tasks.description: Check that the itinerary contains the returned flight and hotel details, covers the full date range day by day, uses only returned prices and availability, and includes an explicit approval request. Ensure no booking is attempted.
tasks.expectedOutput: Validation-confirmed itinerary or a correction requirement if the plan is incomplete or factual data is missing.
